text: 金十数据11月9日讯，天眼查App显示，近日，乌鲁木齐麓北承云科技有限公司成立，法定代表人为邱京昊，注册资本4亿元人民币，经营范围包括信息技术咨询服务、非居住房地产租赁、软件开发等，由北京字跳网络技术有限公司全资持股。
text_en: Jinshi Data, November 9: Tianyancha App shows that Urumqi Lubei Chengyun Technology Co., Ltd. was recently established, with Qiu Jinghao as legal representative and registered capital of RMB 400 million. Its business scope includes information technology consulting services, non-residential real estate leasing, software development, etc. It is wholly owned by Beijing Zitiao Network Technology Co., Ltd.
